99: If I wish etc. - for this reason he stated both: so that he would be able to retract [his participation in the sale]. But the seller cannot retract, as it goes on to elaborate: if the seller would want to retract, he would say to him: "I want my money to effect the acquisition." And if [Rav Idi bar Avin] would want to retract, [Rav Idi] would say to him: "I don't want my money to effect the acquisition until the document arrives; as long as I haven't received the document, I can retract."
